title: 8 Sins a Godly Man Keeps Feeding Without Realizing It
caption:
8 sins a godly man keeps feeding without realizing it. He'd call most of them something softer.

The scroll that isn't porn but isn't innocent either. The resentment you've renamed honesty. The comparison you call ambition. The isolation you call independence.

The anger you call standing up for yourself. The laziness you call resting in God's timing. The lust you call just being a guy. The pride you call confidence.

Call it what it is before it calls the shots.
